native.title: Device notifications
native.intro: Optional. Prepare first, then choose Enable. Preview is off unless you explicitly select it.
native.platform: Web Push, not a native widget. On iPhone/iPad, add this app to the Home Screen and open it there. Browser/OS settings may delay or suppress display.
native.preview: Show sender and affection text on the lock screen (explicit consent)
native.blocked: Sign-out blocked: device opt-out is not confirmed. This account and its recovery identities are retained. Retry while this account is still signed in. Already accepted notifications cannot be recalled.
native.ready: Ready for your explicit opt-in. Browser permission is not server registration.
native.enabled: Enabled and verified by server readback. Device display remains unknown.
native.disabled: Server opt-out verified; browser subscription removed and local notifications closed.
native.unknown: An unmapped browser subscription needs recovery in its original account. It is not adopted or removed here. Use the original account or browser site settings; other devices are not reset.
native.reconcile: The browser VAPID binding differs. Explicitly disable/reconcile this mapped device, then prepare and opt in again. No new identity is created automatically.
native.unsupported: Push is unavailable in this browser/context. Core in-app events still work. On iOS use a supported Home Screen web app.
native.unavailable: Native notifications are not configured for this exact HTTPS app path. In-app events remain available.
native.locale: Save your chosen language with Save preferences before enabling. This does not save your other drafts.
native.storage: Local durable storage failed. Native registration/dispatch is not confirmed; no in-memory success is assumed.
native.denied: Permission denied. Change browser/OS notification settings, then prepare again.
native.uncertain: Operation unconfirmed. Keep this account and the same identity; refresh or retry explicitly.
native.refresh: Authentication changed. Native operations cancelled; prepare again without changing profile drafts.
native.queueFull: Native retry queue full. Earlier uncertain IDs are retained; resolve them before adding more.
native.serverEnabled: This mapped device: server enabled. Preview: {{preview}}.
native.serverDisabled: This mapped device: server disabled. Preview: {{preview}}.
native.eventUnknown: In-app persistence unconfirmed; retry only this same event ID.
native.displayUnknown: Device display: unknown. Provider acceptance is not delivery or a read receipt.
native.retryEvent: Retry native dispatch with the same event ID
